data.narrative:
Swarmbotics AI is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Stephen Houghton and Drew Watson that has raised $17.2M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 10 total peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI—all operating in the same sector and at seed or early Series A stages.

Two methods anchor this analysis. The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $43M based on the $17.2M raised as a valuation proxy. The Peer-Median method examines three directly comparable firms (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M), producing a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $37M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $222M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage defense-tech valuations: stage-progression suggests a conservative $43M floor, while peer comparables—particularly UFORCE at equivalent stage—imply substantially higher values. Key sensitivities include whether the company will achieve Series A funding at rates consistent with top-quartile peers and the timing and magnitude of defense-sector adoption. The $222M median balances these methods but warrants sensitivity testing against near-term funding and product traction indicators.
